correctness.rationale: The integer recurrence B_j=j B_(j-1)+r^j is proved algebraically from the finite defining sum; the prime sieve and complete inner enumeration cover all p<=2339 and 1<=r<p. The C++17 certificate verifies 345 earlier primes, exact histogram and all six roots at p=2339. An independent inverse-factorial mod-p script obtains the same six roots. All checked operations are exact modular integer arithmetic; no infinite inference from finite tests is made.
